import json,subprocess,sys,os,datetime
from pathlib import Path
out=Path(sys.argv[1]); commands=json.loads((out/'COMMANDS.json').read_text())
def state(status,**fields):
 value=dict(status=status,pid=os.getpid(),checked_at=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),**fields)
 tmp=out/'PIPELINE.json.tmp';tmp.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n');tmp.replace(out/'PIPELINE.json')
try:
 for i,args in enumerate(commands):
  state('running',command_index=i,argv=args)
  with (out/('job_%02d.log'%i)).open('ab') as log: subprocess.run(args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  if i==2:
   import torch
   torch.set_num_threads(2)
   parent=torch.load(out/'parent.pt',map_location='cpu',mmap=True,weights_only=False)['model']
   proof={}
   for arm in ('control','attention'):
    model=torch.load(out/arm/'training/last.pt',map_location='cpu',mmap=True,weights_only=False)['model']
    changed=sum(not torch.equal(value,parent[name]) for name,value in model.items() if name in parent)
    assert changed>0
    proof[arm]=dict(changed_original_tensors=changed)
    if arm=='attention':
     value=model['scene_cross_attention.output_projection.weight']
     assert value.abs().sum()>0
     proof[arm]['output_projection_norm']=float(value.norm())
   (out/'UPDATE_SANITY.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')
 state('completed',commands_completed=len(commands))
except BaseException as exc:
 state('failed',error=repr(exc));raise
